Rare.name: Abyss Soldier
Rare.desc: Once per turn: You can discard 1 WATER monster to the Graveyard to target 1 card on the field; return it to the hand.

Rare.name: Dark Master - Zorc
Rare.desc: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Contract with the Dark Master". Once per turn: You can roll a six-sided die, then destroy all monsters your opponent controls if you roll 1 or 2, destroy 1 monster your opponent controls if you roll 3, 4 or 5, or destroy all monsters you control if you roll 6.

Rare.name: Kuriboh
Rare.desc: During damage calculation, if your opponent's monster attacks (Quick Effect): You can discard this card; you take no battle damage from that battle.

Rare.name: Magical Dimension
Rare.desc: If you control a Spellcaster monster: Target 1 monster you control; Tribute that target, then Special Summon 1 Spellcaster monster from your hand, then you can destroy 1 monster on the field.

Rare.name: Morphing Jar
Rare.desc: FLIP: Both players discard as many cards as possible from their hands, then each player draws 5 cards.

Rare.name: Ring of Destruction
Rare.desc: During your opponent's turn: Target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls whose ATK is less than or equal to their LP; destroy that face-up monster, and if you do, take damage equal to its original ATK, then inflict damage to your opponent, equal to the damage you took. You can only activate 1 "Ring of Destruction" per turn.

Common.name: Big Bang Shot
Common.desc: The equipped monster gains 400 ATK. If the equipped monster attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent. When this card leaves the field, banish the equipped monster.

Common.name: Book of Taiyou
Common.desc: Flip 1 face-down monster on the field into face-up Attack Position.

Common.name: Ceasefire
Common.desc: If a face-down Defense Position monster or an Effect Monster is on the field: Change all face-down Defense Position monsters on the field to face-up Defense Position (Flip monsters' effects are not activated at this time), also inflict 500 damage to your opponent for each Effect Monster on the field.

Common.name: Happy Lover
Common.desc: Enemies become overjoyed when struck by the Heart Ray emitted from the forehead of this tiny cherub.

Common.name: Rush Recklessly
Common.desc: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; it gains 700 ATK until the end of this turn.

Common.name: Stray Lambs
Common.desc: Special Summon 2 "Lamb Tokens" (Beast/EARTH/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0) in Defense Position. You cannot Summon other monsters the turn you activate this card (but you can Set).

Common.name: Terraforming
Common.desc: Add 1 Field Spell from your Deck to your hand.

Common.name: Thunder Dragon
Common.desc: You can discard this card; add up to 2 "Thunder Dragon" from your Deck to your hand.

Common.name: Twin-Headed Behemoth
Common.desc: During the End Phase, if this card is in the GY because it was destroyed on the field and sent there this turn: You can Special Summon this card, but its ATK/DEF become 1000. You can only use this effect of "Twin-Headed Behemoth" once per Duel.

Ultra Rare.name: Magical Stone Excavation
Ultra Rare.desc: Discard 2 cards, then target 1 Spell in your GY; add it to your hand.

Super Rare.name: Magician of Faith
Super Rare.desc: FLIP: Target 1 Spell in your GY; add that target to your hand.

Super Rare.name: Nimble Momonga
Super Rare.desc: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: Gain 1000 Life Points, then you can Special Summon any number of "Nimble Momongas" from your Deck in face-down Defense Position.

Super Rare.name: Pyramid Turtle
Super Rare.desc: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: You can Special Summon 1 Zombie monster with 2000 or less DEF from your Deck.

Super Rare.name: Smashing Ground
Super Rare.desc: Destroy the 1 face-up monster your opponent controls that has the highest DEF (your choice, if tied).
